parser:
import re

def parse(lines):
    START = re.compile(r'^Hmm\.\.\.\s+(?:The next patch )?[Ll]ooks like (?:a |an )?(?P<type>.+?) to me\.\.\.$')
    OLD = re.compile(r'^\|--- (?P<file>[^\t]+?)(?:\t(?P<ts>.+))?\s*$')
    NEW = re.compile(r'^\|\+\+\+ (?P<file>[^\t]+?)(?:\t(?P<ts>.+))?\s*$')
    CHECK = re.compile(r'^(?:checking|patching) file (?P<file>.+?)\s*$')
    PLAN = re.compile(r'^Using Plan (?P<plan>\S+?)\.\.\.$')
    HUNK = re.compile(r'^Hunk #(?P<hunk>\d+) (?P<status>succeeded|FAILED|ignored|already applied)(?: at (?P<line>\d+))?(?: with fuzz (?P<fuzz>\d+))?(?: \(offset (?P<offset>-?\d+) lines?\))?\.?\s*$')
    FAIL = re.compile(r'^(?P<failed>\d+) out of (?P<total>\d+) hunks? (?P<status>FAILED|ignored)')
    DONE = re.compile(r'^(?P<v>done)\s*$')
    SKIP = re.compile(r'^(?:-+|The text leading up to this was:|\|.*)\s*$')
    patches, plines = [], []
    hunks, hlines = [], []
    kv, kvlines = {}, []
    skip = []
    cur = None
    def new(t):
        return {'Patch': str(len(patches) + 1), 'Type': t, 'Old file': '', 'Old timestamp': '', 'New file': '', 'New timestamp': '', 'File': '', 'Plan': '', 'Hunks failed': '', 'Hunks total': '', 'Result': ''}
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = START.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = new(m.group('type'))
            patches.append(cur)
            plines.append(i)
            continue
        if cur is None and (OLD.match(l) or NEW.match(l) or CHECK.match(l) or HUNK.match(l)):
            cur = new('')
            patches.append(cur)
        m = OLD.match(l)
        if m:
            cur['Old file'] = m.group('file')
            cur['Old timestamp'] = m.group('ts') or ''
            plines.append(i)
            continue
        m = NEW.match(l)
        if m:
            cur['New file'] = m.group('file')
            cur['New timestamp'] = m.group('ts') or ''
            plines.append(i)
            continue
        m = CHECK.match(l)
        if m:
            cur['File'] = m.group('file')
            plines.append(i)
            continue
        m = PLAN.match(l)
        if m and cur is not None:
            cur['Plan'] = m.group('plan')
            plines.append(i)
            continue
        m = HUNK.match(l)
        if m:
            hunks.append({'Patch': cur['Patch'], 'File': cur['File'], 'Hunk': m.group('hunk'), 'Status': m.group('status'), 'Line': m.group('line') or '', 'Fuzz': m.group('fuzz') or '', 'Offset': m.group('offset') or ''})
            hlines.append(i)
            if not cur['Result'] or m.group('status') != 'succeeded':
                cur['Result'] = 'FAILED' if m.group('status') == 'FAILED' else (cur['Result'] if cur['Result'] == 'FAILED' else m.group('status'))
            continue
        m = FAIL.match(l)
        if m and cur is not None:
            cur['Hunks failed'] = m.group('failed')
            cur['Hunks total'] = m.group('total')
            cur['Result'] = m.group('status')
            plines.append(i)
            continue
        m = DONE.match(l)
        if m:
            kv['Status'] = m.group('v')
            kvlines.append(i)
            continue
        if SKIP.match(l):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if patches:
        blocks.append({'name': 'patches', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': plines, 'records': patches})
    if hunks:
        blocks.append({'name': 'hunks', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': hlines, 'records': hunks})
    if kv:
        blocks.append({'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kvlines, 'records': [kv]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
